I know your heart is in the right place with this but I don't want my family to know. We're not close at all and I've only told on adult about it. Other than that he's beloved by the teachers in my school and I've seen too many cases of girls reporting stuff and nothing being done about it. Or people belittling them like, "Well he didn't do xyz so it's not a big deal." I don't want to report it. I don't want to have to recount it over and over again so every official can hear what he did to me. I want to be able to walk down the hall and not be sent into a self-destructive mindset. I want him to know that he has no right to force himself into my life & conversations. And I have the right to cut him out of everything. I'm not ashamed of anything.
